title: The owner's coffee
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Tuesday. The owner's coffee: one cup, at ten, from a thermos, in a mug that says something the strip draws as blocks. She has never offered. Today there are two mugs on the counter. She doesn't mention it. He drinks it.

panels.composition: The shop, ten AM. The OWNER pouring from a thermos. Two mugs on the counter. WOOD at the mat cutter, seeing two.

image.prompt: a woman pouring coffee from a thermos into one of two mugs on a shop counter while a young man at a mat cutter notices the second mug, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The second mug. A word on it as blocks. Steam.

image.prompt: close on a steaming coffee mug on a counter with a printed word rendered as blocks, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood taking it. The owner back at her station. Nobody says anything about the mug.

image.prompt: a young man taking a mug of coffee from a counter while a woman in reading glasses works at her station with her back turned, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The two mugs, empty, side by side by the sink at four. He washes both. That's the whole arrangement.

image.prompt: close on two empty coffee mugs side by side beside a small sink, black and white, no words

notes: Two mugs. Nobody mentions it. He washes both.
